# IntellicatAI — Free Coding AI Assistant, Free AI Coder, Free Study AI & Homework Helper

> IntellicatAI (also known as Intelicat.AI or Cyber Cat AI) is an all-in-one AI platform providing a 100% free coding AI assistant and free AI coder with Code Mode 2.0 autonomous agent and live website preview sandbox, free study AI and homework helper for math & STEM, and free AI image generation studio.

## Core Capabilities & Operational Modes

### 1. Free Code Mode 2.0 (Autonomous Agent IDE ⚡ 🐾)
- **Autonomous Multi-File Editing**: Plans tasks, creates new files, modifies code, and performs automatic syntax checks.
- **Interactive Live Sandbox**: Google AI Studio style live sandbox rendering HTML, Tailwind CSS, and JavaScript with responsive Desktop (full width), Tablet (768px), and Mobile (375px) toggles.
- **Snapshot Rollback Checkpoints**: Saves instant state rollbacks before each edit so users can undo modifications in one click.
- **Polyglot Code Generation**: TypeScript, Python, Rust, Go, SQL, React 19, C++, Next.js, and Bash with time/space complexity notes.
- **One-Click Actions**: Live Website Preview, Code View with line numbers, Copy snippet, and Download project files.

### 2. Free AI Image Generation Studio 🎨
- Text-to-image studio supporting Flux, SDXL, and Anime models.
- Generates high-definition artwork, wallpapers, game assets, and avatars with custom aspect ratios (1:1, 16:9, 9:16).
- Instant one-click image downloads and prompt enhancers.

### 3. Free Study Material AI & Tutoring Mode 🎓
- Tiered learning hub:
  - **Class 1 to 5**: Foundational arithmetic, pattern recognition, introductory science.
  - **Class 6 to 10**: Algebra, geometry, biology, chemistry, physics fundamentals.
  - **Class 11 to 12**: Advanced calculus, Newtonian & modern physics, organic chemistry, computer science.
  - **College & University**: Data structures, distributed algorithms, system architecture, engineering mathematics.
- Socratic reasoning: explains the governing formulas, breaks problems into numbered steps, states final units, and provides checking tips.

### 4. Search Mode (Real-Time Web Grounding 🌐)
- Real-time live web search integration.
- Retrieves verified articles, factual extracts, and sources.
- Emits clickable source citation chips (`{ title, uri }`) directly in the user interface.
- Fact-checks and synthesizes current news and real-world milestones.

### 5. Fast Mode & Deep Think Mode ⚡ 🧠
- **Fast Mode**: Hyper-concise, sub-300ms direct answers using Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite or Groq LPU models.
- **Deep Think Mode**: Multi-step chain-of-thought analysis, edge-case breakdown, and architectural trade-offs.

### 6. Project Spaces & Virtual Filesystem 📁
- Cloud-persisted project workspaces with customizable title, goal, and notes.
- In-memory virtual directory tree (`/src`, `/components`, `/api`, `/public`).
- Direct context injection into the AI assistant for workspace-aware code generation.

---

## AI Model Architecture

IntellicatAI integrates Google Gemini and Groq LPU models:
- **Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite**: Default ultra-fast engine (~320 tok/s), high daily quota, sub-300ms time to first token.
- **Gemini 3.5 Flash**: Production workhorse with deep reasoning, high uptime, and vision capabilities.
- **Gemini 3.6 Flash**: Multimodal flagship for complex logic, code synthesis, and structured tasks.
- **Gemini 3.7 Flash**: Hybrid chain-of-thought reasoning engine for intricate STEM and architectural problems.
- **Gemini 3.8 Flash Frontier**: Pro/Elite frontier model for high-end reasoning and advanced synthesis.
- **Groq LPUs**: Hyper-accelerated inference with Llama 3.1 8B, Llama 3.3 70B, and Mixtral running at up to 800+ tokens/second.
